title: Docker Sandboxes Promotion | Docker
content_html:
Claim your $250 Cloud Sandbox Credit

Each sandbox is a microVM with its own kernel, running in the cloud. Your agents keep working after you close your laptop.

Get $250 in compute credit when you sign up for Docker Agentic Platform, September 22-30, 2026. Credit card required at signup. Terms Apply.

Offer expires in

00 Days

00 Hours

00 Minutes

00 Seconds

$250 goes a long way

For example, it can run:

Four agents in parallel

Seven hours a day, thirty days

Or about 3,500 short runs

Automated tasks of fifteen minutes each

Priced at Medium: 4 vCPU, 8 GB, $0.280 an hour.
See how pricing is structured

Close your laptop. The work keeps going.

Start an agent in a sandbox, walk away, come back to a finished branch.

Run it in the background

The sandbox runs in the cloud. Nothing depends on your laptop staying awake.

Run several at once

Each agent gets its own sandbox. They install and test without touching each other’s files.

Let the agent install anything

Each microVM has its own kernel. Whatever the agent installs, stays inside.

Common questions

Learn more about our limited-time offer for Cloud Sandbox compute credits.

What are the offer terms?

New Docker Agentic Platform signups receive a one-time $250 compute credit in lieu of the standard $25 credit. Limit one per user and account. Valid credit card required at signup; the card will be charged only for usage beyond the credit. Offer valid September 30, 2026, 11:59 PM PT. Credits are non-transferable, have no cash value, and expire 6 months after redemption. Subject to these offer terms and Docker’s SSA. Docker may modify or end this offer at any time. Void where prohibited. Terms apply: Terms of Usage | Privacy Policy 

How is pricing structured?

Sandboxes bill by the second for compute, from start to stop. Your $250 credit is drawn down first; your card is charged only for usage beyond it. Sizes and rates:

When does the credit expire?

Six months after you claim it. Anything unused at that point is forfeited, and you are never charged for it.

What counts against the credit?

Sandbox compute only, measured from start to stop. Setup, idle time, and retries all count. Model API usage and agent subscriptions are billed separately by their providers.

Who can claim it?

Anyone who signs up between September 22–30, 2026, one credit per account. Terms and conditions apply.

Set your agents to YOLO mode

Estimates cover sandbox compute only. Model API usage and agent subscriptions are billed separately. Hours per day are assumed workloads, not limits. Billed time includes setup, idle time, and retries. Rates current as of September 2026.
